title: Quanto Agroworld IPO Details
intro:
Quanto Agroworld IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹31.02 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 46.30 lakh shares of ₹31.02 crore.

Quanto Agroworld IPO opens for subscription on Sep 15, 2026 and closes on Sep 17, 2026. The allotment for the Quanto Agroworld IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 18, 2026. Quanto Agroworld IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 22, 2026.

Quanto Agroworld IPO is set final issue price at ₹67 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,68,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹4,02,000.

Sobhagya Capital Options Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Quanto Agroworld IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

about.text:
Incorporated in 2018, Quanto Agroworld Limited (QuantoAgro) is engaged in the business of sustainable, chemical-free farming of medicinal and aromatic plants, producing essential oils and related products for industries such as pharmaceuticals, home and personal care, food and beverage, and aromatherapy.

The company has been allotted agricultural land of 800+ acres through Maharashtra State Farming Corporation Limited (“MSFCL”), of which, 424 acres is used for cultivation and additional 312.57 acres of land is under development.

The company operates on B2B business model, supplying lemongrass biomass to herbal tea manufacturers, nutraceutical companies and functional beverage brands, and lemongrass tea-cut and essential oil to personal care, home care, fragrance, aromatherapy and certain pharmaceutical application.

As on the date of DRHP, it has an installed oil processing capacity of 11.25 metric tonnes per annum at the Ravalgaon facility.

objectives: 1 — Capital Expenditure for Distillation Plant at Rawalgaon, Maharashtra
2 — Capital Expenditure for expansion of Farms
3 — Prepayment or repayment of all or a portion of certain outstanding borrowings availed by the Company

faqs.question: How to apply in Quanto Agroworld IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Quanto Agroworld IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Quanto Agroworld IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Quanto Agroworld IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Quanto Agroworld IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Quanto Agroworld IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Quanto Agroworld IPO opens on Tue, Sep 15, 2026 and closes on Thu, Sep 17, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Quanto Agroworld IPO?
faqs.answer: Quanto Agroworld IPO lot size is 2000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,68,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Quanto Agroworld IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Quanto Agroworld IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Quanto Agroworld IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Quanto Agroworld IPO will be done on Friday, September 18, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Mon, Sep 21, 2026 . Check the Quanto Agroworld IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Quanto Agroworld IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Quanto Agroworld IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Tue, Sep 22, 2026 .
